title: Dynamic Boy
tagline: Dynamic Boy is a platform where users can upload games, check ranking information, and share on social media, fostering interaction and competition within the gaming community.
description:
In the recent Web3 market, Game-Fi services are experiencing a resurgence, and the gaming industry is expected to continue growing and evolving into the future. To capitalize on these trends and provide users with a platform to showcase their skills, popularity, and enjoyability within games, we have developed the Dynamic Boy platform.

Our platform not only allows gamers to assess their positions and skills within games conveniently but also empowers game developers to upload their creations. This enables developers to gauge the popularity and enjoyment of their games among users, receive feedback on their development skills, understand what information and fun aspects are essential in game development, and ultimately improve their games. Through Dynamic Boy, we aim to contribute to the fun and advancement of the gaming industry.

A Web3-based game ranking platform allows users to play games and measure rankings for each game, providing them within the platform. These rankings can be viewed by users on our Dynamic Boy platform and can also be uploaded to various social media platforms.

Moreover, regular users can develop games themselves and upload them to the platform. These uploaded games are managed directly by administrators, who can use a dashboard to monitor which games are actively operating, which users hold high rankings in specific games, participation rates, and other diverse statistical information.

In summary, this platform offers the following functionalities:
1. Game Ranking Provision: Users play games to measure rankings for each game, which can be viewed within the platform.
2. Social Media Integration: Game ranking information can be uploaded to various social media platforms.
3. User Game Upload: Regular users can develop games themselves and upload them to the platform.
4. Administrator Dashboard: Administrators manage uploaded games and provide a dashboard to monitor game operation status and user statistical information.
how_its_made:
The Dynamic Boy platform is meticulously engineered using cutting-edge technologies and frameworks to ensure a seamless user experience. Leveraging the power of the Dynamic API, our platform offers effortless login capabilities, enabling users to access a wide array of features with ease. Additionally, we've implemented standardized network provision protocols to guarantee optimal performance, providing gamers and developers alike with a reliable and efficient platform for gaming and game development.

Furthermore, the platform is built on the BASE network. Additionally, we allow game scores to be registered on smart contracts, enabling users to share their scores across various social media platforms seamlessly.

Moreover, each game developed by game developers is provided in the form of NFTs, and developers mint their games upon registration. In the future, rewards for these game NFTs, along with various information such as scores and account details for various games, will be available. The information input during game registration is stored in the form of metadata, which is then saved on IPFS.
